scope: 62 published chapter routes. Compared source material and the signed v0.33 edition for revised questions, table data, diagrams, working and reveal targets. 61 PowerPoint source files match their recorded hashes. For Pure Year 1 Chapter 8, the 39-slide reviewed source import matches the recorded edition. The current PowerPoint file has a different checksum. Its teaching content matches the prior reviewed deck apart from cover labels.

Each slide was rendered closed and fully revealed at desktop size. Browser checks exercised sequential Next, direct controls, reset and Space in a tablet-sized Chromium viewport. All retained answer controls have explicit answer owners. Exam references and the named original-to-display mapping are preserved.

Every A4 booklet was rendered and its panels checked. The separate print design keeps graphical table cells intact, preserves supplied theory, and allocates independent writing areas to worked tasks. Non-Statistics visual review includes cross-chapter samples, comparison of regenerated PDF text and checking page geometry. Statistics reviewers additionally inspected the chapter page atlases and individual corrected pages.

Actual pointer, keyboard and emulated touch checks included out-of-order selection followed by Space and Reset, horizontal drags with click suppression, reloads, blank taps, and horizontal wheel momentum. No physical iPad or physical Magic Mouse test in Chrome or Safari is claimed. Native browser history gestures intercepted before a page receives wheel events are outside page control.
exceptions: Authentic charts, original graphs, calculator screens, demonstration artwork and expressly approved image-only Pure Year 2 Chapter 1 slides 43 and 44 are retained. Original Core Pure exercise-reference slides contain a reference without the exercise text.

The source question uses 121, 145 and 104 members for the cricket, hockey and squash strata; the worked sample uses these figures. Source inconsistencies in binomial critical regions, regression units and Normal distribution examples were reconciled with the printed question data.
Physical Magic Mouse and iPad checks remain open. Provider token counts and billing usage were unavailable.
